narration: For {identical_months} month the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month}, with payday still days off, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, the cushion under each life no longer quite the same size. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the money was as far apart as it would ever be, and the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Its days held a fraction more living and a fraction less getting by, its Life {life_gap}.
